english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to say someone assumes the worst about other people's motives.

exampleSentences.english: He's really cynical and always thinks people have ulterior motives when they help.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢真係將人諗得好衰，成日覺得人哋幫手都有目的。
